text:
akiko: quick heads-up, bringing up lumen-v2 (q8) on staging for localized smoke. small eval shows ja->en BLEU dip on subtitle-style samples with inline ruby/furigana and injected ZWSPs.
omar: can you share the exact eval command and a tiny input sample?
akiko: eval: `./runtest --model lumen-v2 --quant q8 --lang ja-en --split subtitles --batch 16 --seed 42`
akiko: sample: `日本語：「椒」有言を語ります。「椅」(フリガナ:カ)。`  (ruby marker in parens + hidden ZWSPs between kanji/ruby)
vikram: interesting. on sight this looks like a detokenization/dotmap mismatch for ruby markers. what does the tokenizer output look like fp16 vs q8?
akiko: pasted short diff: `FP16 tokens: [...., '椅フリガナ', ...]` vs `Q8 tokens: [...., '椅', 'フリガナ', ...]` (ruby got split off).
nina: split near ruby seems to cause punctuation attachment errors in detok (we lose the opening quote on rejoin sometimes). that inflates sentence mismatch and BLEU hits the subtitles split hard.
eval-bot: short stats (subtitles subset n=2k):
```
model= lumen-v2
FP16 ja->en BLEU=32.7
Q8   ja->en BLEU=29.4   (delta -3.3)
ruby-split-rate(inputs)=1.6%
detok-quote-loss-rate=0.8%
```
omar: also check vertical layout artifacts: some subtitle sources include U+FEFF or narrow no-break spaces around ruby; the q8 runtime has a post-tokenize sanitizer that toggles on in embedded-mode which might be over-eager.
vikram: could be the joiner heuristic in the tokenizer that was simplified for speed in the quantized runtime. I pushed a micro-optim last week: `tokenizer/fast-joiner`.
akiko: repro note: the worst cases have ruby inside parentheses or angle brackets and adjacent punctuation, or when ZWSP is present between kanji and ruby.
nina: besides ja->en, please smoke ar->en and he->en. we've seen bracket mirroring flip on quant builds before when joined with bidi markers.
eval-bot: ar->en quick smoke (n=500): FP16 BLEU=30.2, Q8 BLEU=29.9, bracket-mirror-flips=0.6% (sample)
omar: lower severity on arabic here but still worth guarding. can someone run a tokenizer-only unit diff across the full eval set and output top 50 frequent token splits?
akiko: running tokenizer diff now and uploading to the triage doc: https://redwood-internal/triage/lumenv2-ruby-zwsp-rtl . I'll include raw token id dumps and the small failing inputs.
vikram: plan: 1) run tokenizer unit diff and bisect `tokenizer/fast-joiner` change, 2) run q8 with `tokenizer=pin-slow` to see if BLEU regresses disappear, 3) add tiny ruby+zwsp testcase to CI smoke.
nina: i'll author a tiny detok test to assert quote and bracket preservation through quant path.
eval-bot: extra metrics (toy subset ruby-heavy n=200):
```
precision ruby-span(fp16)=0.995
precision ruby-span(q8)=0.943
avg token_delta_per_sent=0.42
```
omar: thanks. if bisect shows the tokenizer micro-opt, we can ship a hotfix asap and pin q8 canary. ping me when diffs land. :rocket:
akiko: will update thread with diffs & artifacts in ~1h. thanks all.
